_comment: Shape-prior experiment. Single-variable change from lizard_heatmap_baseline.json: variant heatmap -> heatmap_shape, which projects the decoded coordinates onto a point-distribution model. PREREQUISITE: generate the basis first with `python -m landmarking.scripts.shape_bound_report --config landmarking/config/defaults/lizard.json --by-class --save-basis runs/lizard/shape_bound/shape_basis.npz`. shape_components=8 sits between the measured oracle bound at k=6 (2.6px finger / 2.1px toe) and k=9 (1.4 / 1.2), against ~6.5px unconstrained.
